title: I Hypnotized Your Phone Away
description:
Yes, check your phone again. You were probably going to anyway.

How many times have you picked it up today without having any real reason? That little screen has learned exactly how to get your attention, and you have obediently responded often enough that you barely notice yourself doing it anymore.

I noticed.

I Hypnotized Your Phone Awaytakes that habit and puts it directly into My hands. If your attention can be trained this easily by notifications, scrolling, and the possibility of finding something interesting, imagine what Goddess Amethyst can do once I decide that training has been focused in entirely the wrong direction.

Your phone wants your attention, but so do I.

Unfortunately for your phone, I know exactly what I am doing.

Keep it nearby when you press play because I want the temptation within reach. I want you to notice that familiar urge to check, and then I want you to experience what happens whenMy voice gets there first.

How many times will you reach for your phone before you start hearing Goddess Amethyst telling you to put it down?

There is only one way to satisfy that curiosity.
author: Mistress Amethyst
